system.description:
• Effect: Your Sneak Attack hits on a creature you have a Dossier on open a wound: it loses 3d6 HP at the start of each of its turns and can't regain Hit Points while it bleeds.
  • The wound closes when an ally spends an action and succeeds on a Wisdom check against your Class Save DC (one wound at a time; against a solo, the bleeding ends when it becomes Bloodied).
  • Creatures that don't bleed are unaffected.

rules.value: Open Vein: a Sneak Attack hit on a creature you have a Dossier on opens a wound: it loses 3d6 HP at the start of each of its turns and can't regain HP while it bleeds. An ally closes it with an action and a Wisdom check against your Class Save DC (one wound at a time; a solo stops bleeding when Bloodied). Creatures that don't bleed are unaffected.
